text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wall was still too high after all. 
Unable to overcome her fear of the pack, 
Tamamo Cross was defeated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The White Lightning isn't done yet!" That 
desperate cry pierced the heavens like a 
bolt of thunder.
